en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 1.Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated to us saying, “Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated to us, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū Baṣīr, from one of the two [Imams] (a) who said, ‘

When it is Friday and the people of Paradise are in Paradise while the people of Hell are in the Fire, the inhabitants of Paradise will know that it is Friday due to what they witness of enhanced pleasure and joy, while the denizens of Hell will know that it is Friday because of the [increased] torment by the wardens of Hell.’”
